@[simp]
theorem cof_preOmega {o : Ordinal} (ho : IsSuccPrelimit o) : (preOmega o).cof = o.cof := by

  · simp [h.eq_bot]
  · exact isNormal_preOmega.cof_eq ⟨h, ho⟩

@[simp]
theorem cof_omega {o : Ordinal} (ho : IsSuccLimit o) : (ω_ o).cof = o.cof :=
